name: Clicking a Group A team row reaches a destination that surfaces Group A context
description: When a visitor clicks a team row inside Group A and arrives at the destination, the destination page surfaces Group A as context — proving group identity propagates with the navigation.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the group standings area
Click the first team row inside Group A
Verify the destination URL differs from the homepage URL

Verify the destination page surfaces a Group A indicator — accepting any of the literal text 'Group A', the standalone letter A in a stage/group context label, breadcrumb, heading, badge, or a URL path segment containing 'group-a' or '/a/'
